parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is one leg of the pliers, made of high-strength steel, forming one of the two handles and jaws.
parts.Functional_description: It provides leverage and transmits force to the jaws for gripping or cutting objects.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, including the pivot and gripping jaws.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main structural component, holding the pivot and providing the gripping or cutting surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary relative to the other leg except for the pivoting motion that allows the jaws to open and close.
